sources.title: Sources

dropbox.title: Cloud sync (Dropbox / Google Drive)
dropbox.intro: Distil a folder from Dropbox or Google Drive into an output folder on either. Every file is verified against its source; only files that pass are published.
dropbox.notAuthorised: Not connected yet: {{roles}}. An administrator can connect it under Settings → Cloud storage.
dropbox.source: Source folder — Dropbox path (/AS 3500), Dropbox website address, Dropbox shared link or Google Drive folder link (read only)
dropbox.dest: Output folder — Dropbox path (/Transfer_Md), Dropbox website address, shared link or Google Drive folder link (a folder of your own)
dropbox.dryRun: Dry run — distil and check only, upload nothing
dropbox.force: Re-distil files that have not changed
dropbox.safety: The source folder is only read and is checked unchanged at the end. Failed or uncertain files are not published. A published run can be rolled back.
dropbox.sourceChanged: The source folder changed during the run — check the log.
dropbox.rollbackConfirm: Restore the previous versions of everything run {{run}} published?
dropbox.scanHint: This file is a scan: every page is read by two OCR engines, which takes about a minute per page on this machine.
dropbox.soFar: So far: {{pass}} passed · {{review}} need review · {{fail}} failed · {{skipped}} unchanged
dropbox.cancelConfirm: Stop this run? Files already checked are kept in the log; nothing more is published.
dropbox.quiet: No new output for a while — normal during a long step (a large scan or a big file). The run is still active while the spinner turns.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.emptyHint: Jobs appear here when a distillation starts.

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyHint: Distilled, verified documents are listed here.
documents.instruction: Contains text that looks like instructions to an AI

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Language and theme are chosen in the top bar.

storage.title: Cloud storage
storage.intro: Connect Dropbox once here; the connection is saved on this server and used by Dropbox sync. Two separate accesses keep sources safe: one can only read, the other may write only to output folders.
storage.readerHint: Read-only: used for every source folder. It cannot change anything in Dropbox.
storage.writerHint: Used only to publish into the output folders you choose; source folders are protected by the app.
storage.connectedUnchecked: Saved, but Dropbox did not answer — check the connection
storage.disconnectConfirm: Remove this Dropbox connection from the server?
storage.step1: Open Dropbox and click Allow (opens a new tab)
storage.step2: Copy the code Dropbox shows and paste it below.
storage.helpTitle: Where do I get an App key?
storage.help1: Sign in at dropbox.com/developers/apps and open (or create) your app with “Scoped access” and “Full Dropbox”.
storage.help2: On the Permissions tab tick files.metadata.read, files.content.read, sharing.read, account_info.read (and files.content.write for the write access), then Submit.
storage.help3: Copy the App key from the Settings tab into the field above. You can use one app for both accesses or a separate read-only app.
storage.connectedNoName: Connected — works; reconnect once to show the account name

google.title: Google Drive
google.intro: Use Google Drive folders as sources or outputs. Read access uses Google's read-only Drive permission; write access is used only for the output folders you choose.
google.redirect: Authorised redirect URI to register in Google Cloud Console:
google.failed: Google Drive was not connected ({{reason}}). Try Connect again.
google.helpTitle: How do I create the OAuth client?
google.help1: In Google Cloud Console create (or pick) a project and enable the Google Drive API.
google.help2: OAuth consent screen: choose Internal (Workspace) or External and add yourself as a test user.
google.help3: Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → type “Web application”; add the redirect URI shown above.
google.help4: Copy the client ID and secret into this page, save, then click Connect for each access.

distill.title: Distill
distill.intro: Each room has its own input, output and rules. A run distills; accepting sends the results that qualify to the output folder.
distill.emptyHint: Create a room, choose its input folder and start it.
distill.numberGuard: Hold back files with a number difference
distill.acceptBody: They are sent to {{dest}}. Files below the threshold are not included. You can roll the run back afterwards.
distill.needOutput: Set an output folder to accept results.
distill.interruptedNote: The run stopped before it finished. Start it again and it carries on with the files not done yet.
distill.noFilesYet: No files yet. Start the room to read the input folder.
distill.overlap: The output folder must be outside the input folder.
distill.impact: {{new}} new, {{replaces}} replace the copy in the output folder.
distill.impactUnknown: Could not check the output folder.

cmp.title: {{name}} against the output folder
cmp.new: Not in the output folder yet. Accepting adds it.
cmp.same: Same as the copy in the output folder (only the acceptance details differ).
cmp.changed: Compared with the output folder: {{added}} lines added, {{removed}} removed.
cmp.truncated: Only the first part of the differences is shown.
cmp.binary: Not a text file: compared by size only.

fix.title: {{name}}
fix.remember: Fix a misread and remember it
fix.hint: Type the wrong text exactly as it appears below (or select it there), then the correct text. The fix is kept as a rule and applied wherever the same text appears.
fix.numberNote: A number is fixed only where the text around it is exactly:
fix.saved: Saved as rule #{{num}} and applied to this document.
fix.othersWaiting: {{count}} other documents have the same text.
fix.cut: The rest of the text is not shown.

corrections.title: Correction library
corrections.intro: Fixes people confirmed. A rule is applied only where the original reading matches it exactly; numbers also need the same text around them.
corrections.emptyHint: Open a file in a distill room, choose Fix, and confirm a correction.
corrections.changedOn_one: It now applies to 1 document. Apply it there now?
corrections.changedOn_other: It now applies to {{count}} documents. Apply it there now?
corrections.changedOff_one: 1 document still has this fix. Take it out now?
corrections.changedOff_other: {{count}} documents still have this fix. Take it out now?
corrections.keepsUndone: Places where a person undid the rule stay as they are. Changed documents that were accepted need accepting again.
